product_platform_improvements.problem: The existing AI helper supported four vendors directly, accepted a broad serialized case object, lacked a registered-tool server identity contract, and had incomplete user transparency and operations controls.
product_platform_improvements.implementation: Implemented an OpenAI-only central Responses API gateway with exact portal/tool allowlists, server-to-server authentication, minimal structured input projection, instruction/data isolation, injection detection, strict JSON Schema output validation, bounded timeout and quota controls, circuit breaker, cost hard stop, global and tool flags, metadata-only operational evidence, deterministic fallback, public transparency, and protected owner operations visibility.
product_platform_improvements.before_state: Direct multi-vendor helper with alternate key variables and no central machine-readable contract or five-product maturity matrix.
product_platform_improvements.after_state: One central OpenAI-only registered-tool gateway, five registered bounded tools, five-product capability matrix, dark launch flags, no-key-in-portal architecture, and deterministic non-AI continuity.
product_platform_improvements.benefit: Creates a safe, minimal, OpenAI-only launch architecture without exposing secrets or making nonessential AI a dependency of public legal access.
limitations: No live API request, provider billing, protected key, deployment, portal adapter compatibility receipt, or production evidence exists in this local build.
Domestic Violence Aid remains closed by design pending separate survivor-safety and privacy acceptance.

builder_prompt_system_improvements.problem: The release system did not bind the successor overlay identity or fail when active configuration reintroduced alternate vendors, arbitrary prompts, content logging, missing kill switches, or overstated live maturity.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.implementation: Added an exact overlay checkpoint, machine-readable gateway/model/tool/capability records, an OpenAI launch governance validator, two mock/synthetic regression suites, and current release evidence that separates TESTED dark code from live smoke, deployment and stabilization.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.before_state: V12 dual-track checks existed, but no overlay-specific OpenAI launch gate or exact five-product AI receipt existed.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.after_state: Ordinary release acceptance now includes exact overlay identity, OpenAI-only active config, registered tools, injection and schema isolation, metadata-only logs, no live-smoke claim, and closed deployment gates.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.future_build_benefit: Future AI changes must remain OpenAI-only, registered, schema-bound, privacy-minimized, exact-evaluated, and truthful about dark, canary, open, degraded, killed and blocked states.
limitations: Repository, GitHub branch, Render service, OpenAI project, billing, key and live environment were not accessible and therefore were not fabricated or modified.
